newsitem.title: USA: American ECO affirms year-to-date EPS.
newsitem.headline: American ECO affirms year-to-date EPS.

text.p: American ECO Corp said Tuesday that its accounting firm, Karlins Fuller Arnold & Klodosky LLP, confirmed the company's recently announced earnings of $0.61 per share for the nine months ending November 30, 1996.

The company said its accounting firm stated in a letter that it is "not aware of any material modifications that should be made to the accompanying financial statements for them to be in conformity with generally accepted accounting principles."
The company issued the information a day after its chief financial officer, John Walker, resigned for reasons that were not specified by the company.
